create_vit_wrapper: create a DinoVisionTransformerWrapper to extract intermediate layers from a ViT backbone model
get_backbone_out_indices: get output layer indices for a ViT backbone using FOUR_EVEN_INTERVALS strategy
configure_backbone_layers: configure DinoVisionTransformerWrapper to extract the last 4 layers from a backbone model
adapt_patch_size: create a DinoVisionTransformerWrapper with center padding to adapt input images to patch size
freeze_backbone_encoder: create a DinoVisionTransformerWrapper that freezes the backbone model gradients for inference
